reviews.text: Life Changing!. I have been using this app for years as a way to get in activity daily at home. The video offerings are incredible and always leave me in an amazing mood. I’ve used the app daily to perform yoga, meditation and Pilates. My life has changed in such a positive way from incorporating these videos into my daily routine. My anxiety has been greatly reduced, my mental health has improved, my physical strength and flexibility have grown tremendously. I would highly recommend.

Best Asana App. I have practiced with Boho nearly every day for five years, and I don’t know what my life would look like without their classes. I was drawn to Juliana’s classes on YT because they were filmed outside, and I kept going back because I liked that she always set an intention or mantra, and her perfect form really landed with me as a visual learner with built-in conditioning from childhood gymnastics and ballet. 

I did Juliana’s classes exclusively in the 1.5 years leading up to my 200 hr YTT, and I went into it with a beginner’s mindset thinking I’d be with yogis who much more seasoned than I. I was one of the freshest students, but better prepared than anyone when it came to form and Sanskrit names for poses. I think this speaks to how authentic the content is.

Whenever Boho releases clothes or a new premium program, I buy it to support them because the value I have received from subscribing to the app for almost 5 years far exceeds whatever it has cost. Boho is THE best asana app, without a doubt.

The best yoga App. I have used Boho Beautifuls videos and app for the past 5 years for daily workouts and yoga videos. I love how each instructor blends the breath with the body, for a conscious workout.

Favorite. I’ve done many yoga classes over the years and always end up coming back to Boho Beautiful. Every workout brings me calmness as well and building strength. I also love all the options in class lentil got into my busy schedule.

Love this app!. I enjoy all the variety of yoga and meditation classes. Especially as a busy small business owner I can choose what will fit my schedule ! Mark and Julianna are beautiful souls and I am grateful to be apart of this community!

I use this every day!. Boho Beautiful is amazing!! There is a huge variety of videos available and I use it almost every day. There are no adds and I love the background music to the videos. My favorite are the 10- 15 min core strength videos which have helped me to add variety and excitement to my core every day. I always finish every video feeling refreshed and with a happier, more positive mindset on life.
Best App Ever!. Juliana and Mark have created such a well rounded app with tools to heal mind, body and spirit. Love it!!!

A must have with a busy schedule. I recently subscribed a few months ago to reconnect with myself during busy times. Juliana and Mark bring positivity, peace and warmth to their videos that make them truly welcoming and authentic. I have also loved the backdrops they use for their videos as it has felt like an escape during the cold winter months!
I am very glad I found Boho Beautiful as their meditations have been a valuable addition to my morning routine :)
Incredible energy. I have been using Boho Beautiful for about two years and absolutely love it. Juliana’s energy is so calm and inspiring and the workout is just the added bonus.

Beautiful App, Life Changing Content. I have been practicing with Boho Beautiful for years now and have benefitted greatly from their sincere offerings. For me, yoga has been a means of healing from abuse, crippling depression, and physical injury from a previous professional ballet career. I am now on the other side of these trials, and have such gratitude for the blessings that I have received through practicing with Mark and Juliana. You will not regret becoming a part of this community and partaking of the tranquility that comes from these yoga practices.

Changed my whole workout experience. Love, love, Boho beautiful!! As runner and always lifting weights my body tired and injured. Doing the workouts not only helped the pain it also increased my flexibility, core strength and overall well being! Thank you boho beautiful!!❤️

This App is a Gift. I’ve been following Boho Beautiful since the very beginning, and they’ve been a steady source of peace, strength, and inspiration in my life. Juliana and Mark pour so much heart into everything they do it’s more than just movement, it’s a full mind-body-soul experience. I’ve always felt like they genuinely care about their community and are constantly giving whether it’s free content, encouraging words, or just their calming presence. Supporting them is something I feel good about they’re absolutely worth investing in. Boho Beautiful isn’t just a wellness brand to me it’s a gift, and I’m so grateful for the journey they’ve shared with us.
My go to app. When I first watched their video in Youtube, I was mesmerized. I know it will help me a lot. I subscribed right away. Im obsessed with meditations and cardio hit/pilates/yoga.

Boho beautiful. I absolutely love this app! It has helped me slow down and focus on dialing in my yoga and meditation practice. The YouTube videos are great as well, but i love the exclusive content found only on the app! I also love that you can close your phone while a meditation plays!

Love what this membership has to offer. I am so glad I found this company. It has been vital for my fitness and personal journey… thank you, you
 guys! 🌻

Hooked. I was looking for some bedtime yoga videos on YouTube stumbled across this channel and instantly was hooked. After further research found this app and it’s everything I’ve been looking for but haven’t been able to find

The best for yoga, Pilates, meditation, tapping. Constant content that keeps coming and is worth the $. I’ve been flowing with Julia and mark for over 10 years now and I am so grateful for their practice and platform.

Best app ever!. I have been following Juliana and Mark for the past 11-12 years and absolutely enjoy their workouts! It wasn’t until just recently that I downloaded their app and completely fell in love! There’s so many videos at all sodden levels, challenges, and the app helps me keep track of what I’ve done! Thank you so much for this app!
BB. I recently discovered BB a few months ago. Julianna and Mark put so much love, passion, and energy into there practices they are one of a kind. I will continue to use this app for years to come.🩷

Bohemian Bliss. My dear friend Mara suggested Boho at the beginning of Covid. And there started my bohemian rhapsody of meditations , yoga, yoga retreat, Ascension, buying my favorite yoga pants and just feelingg like I always had a place to travel and heal and grow on the mat. 

5 years later I’m meeting all the newbies offered and enjoying always Julianna and Mark.

I’m in awe of all of it! See you in Barbados, love it there! THANK YOU forever!

All in One Place Yoga/Pilates. I was looking for a more challenging, Yoga / intro to Pilates workout.. I searched a lot of different. And this is the one that I found that was the most body friendly the instructors shows different levels of how to achieve the pose in progress so virtually anybody at any level can do the practices… it’s very body friendly for any age and I’m in my upper 50s who just recently started doing yoga and Pilates five years ago.. there’s so much to this app that you really need to take a look at it and enjoy it… enjoying my friends

Absolutely Transformed My Wellness Journey!. Boho Beautiful has become an absolutely essential part of my daily routine, and I can't recommend this app highly enough! From the moment I downloaded it, I was impressed by the beautifully designed interface and the incredible variety of content available.

The yoga flows are diverse and cater to all levels, from beginner to advanced. I especially appreciate the clear instruction and the calming presence of Juliana and Mark. They create such a peaceful and encouraging atmosphere that makes even challenging poses feel accessible.

Beyond yoga, the fitness and meditation sections are equally fantastic. The fitness workouts are effective and enjoyable, and the guided meditations have been instrumental in helping me manage stress and improve my mindfulness.

What truly sets Boho Beautiful apart is the quality of the videos. The stunning locations are so inspiring, and the production value is top-notch. It feels like you're escaping to a tranquil paradise while you're working on your well-being.

The app is also incredibly user-friendly. It's easy to navigate, find specific types of classes, and track your progress. The ability to download videos for offline use is a huge bonus for when I'm traveling or don't have reliable internet.

Boho Beautiful has not only improved my physical health but also my mental and emotional well-being. It's more than just a fitness app, it's a holistic approach to living a more balanced and fulfilling life. If you're looking for a comprehensive and inspiring platform to support your wellness goals, look no further Boho Beautiful is worth every single star!

Absolute Best Fitness App. This app makes it easy for anyone to reach their fitness goals !! There are a wide variety of 
Videos , calendar to plan and track workouts with an incredible amount of new content. You’ll never be bored.

Healing. I took a break from yoga for a while to do some strength training but always kept my boho beautiful subscription ongoing because of the incredible and effective classes. They touch on all areas of your life with meditations, different types of yoga, nutrition, emotional and spiritual wellness.
Awesome. Love the scenery, the music, the yoga and the mediation. I didn’t do yoga or meditation before this app. It is a game changer

My go to yoga app. I’ve tried a lot of yoga apps over the years but NOTHING compares to boho beautiful. It’s more than just yoga- it’s a whole experience! Whether I need a gentle flow, a powerful workout, a meditation or just a moment of peace, they always have something that fits!
This app has truly become a sacred part of my daily routine. Highly recommend to anyone looking to move their body, connect to their breath and feel more present in their life❤️❤️
Love & Light is Right!. Recently, this app brought me back from depression…Thank you for this body & soul loving community. It is impossible to take part without feeling peace and joy.

Wonderful program. I found Boho Beautiful Yoga on you tube and tried a few meditations and beginner videos and fell in love with Juliana and her teaching , I have been practicing daily now as well as reading the eckhart books. I just signed up for the free trial and I am confident I will be continuing this subscription monthly . Thank you for sharing your experience and the practices 🩵Heather
Best yoga app. I love the Boho Beautiful app! There are so many options for whatever mood you are in and how much time you have.

Love it, always!. I’ve been a fan of Boho Beautiful for many years, and this app brought my passion to a whole new level! Very convenient and packed with lots of awesome features and exclusive videos you won’t find on Youtube. Totally worth the cost!

Life changing app. I have been following Boho for 7+ years. Boho Beautiful makes everyday of my life better. My entire family utilizes the app daily. I am a busy mom of three young kids and work full-time. I enjoy my precious moments with the Boho family. I am forever grateful to have this treasure in my life. It has made me a better person and I try to share it with the world.

What a wonderful app. I signed up for Boho Beautiful over a month ago for the mediations. They have been wonderful! Now I will be venturing into yoga practice. It’s been many years since I practiced, but the Boho people have made it become a priority again using this app. Thank you!

Fantastic App!. I’d been practicing yoga and Pilates with Boho Beautiful for over 2 years on YouTube and loved it, but wanted to expand my options, so gave the app a go. Talk about broadening the option universe! There’s every possible option to customize your yoga journey to your timeline, level and ability. I have favorited so many classes and programs, but never get a chance return to them because there’s always new content and options to try out. I could probably do a different video every day for 4 years and still not have done everything on the app! I love it and highly recommend it!!❤️

Blissful journey with Juliana and Mark. I have been part of the boho community for years but just started doing yoga as daily routine this year. Thanks to the Daily Dose program feeling totally different now. So grateful that I can get connected with Juliana and Mark, it is not only a physical workout also mentally strengthening. THANK YOU! Namaste ❤️❤️❤️

This amazing app changed my life. I have been using the boho beautiful app for 3 years now. I started during a time in my life where I felt very lost. I had never practiced yoga or meditation before but came across an ad online and just began one day. I started small with morning meditations and moved into a daily yoga practice which was challenging for me but the words that Juliana and Mark used to reassure me that I didn’t need to be perfect but I was exactly where I needed to be really helped me to keep going and I quickly saw myself getting stronger each day. This practice helped me to find myself and my purpose and has been a shining light on my darkest days. I am forever thankful that I just started that day. I love how easy the app is to navigate and how caring each and every teacher is on the platform. Thank you for developing this app and sharing your love for yoga and your lifestyle with the world. Your love and light have left a lasting impression on me that I hope to carry forth throughout my daily life.
Endless Content. So many amazing, creative classes. Staying consistent is easy now!

Ease and flow with confidence. I have been a subscriber to Boho Beautiful’s patrion page before the app was developed. I love all the videos, the music the backgrounds are gorgeous and meditations are simple, serene and lovely. The app has been easy to Navigate. You can search for a topic you are working with or just stick with the monthly theme for a new video every day. There are new videos added regularly.

The ABSOLUTE BEST for online yoga, meditation, and fitness!. I've been a Boho Beautiful member for 5 years and it keeps getting better! I first fell in love with the scenery, you get to do yoga in beautiful places all around the world. I love the classes so much and the way the site is organized and customizable. Mark and Juliana pour their heart and soul into everything they bring here, and I love the new instructors they have added as well. Top notch, high quality content!

Highly recommend!. Boho Beautiful is my go-to fitness app, and I’ve been subscribed for two years. I love that I don’t need a gym because the workouts are challenging, effective, and totally worth it. The app also includes meditations, which help me feel great both physically and spiritually. It’s a well-rounded platform that keeps me motivated and engaged in my practice. Highly recommend!

Best yoga and fitness app. I love Boho Beautiful and this app. They have the best yoga and fitness videos and I love their meditations. I originally subscribed to the app shortly after they first created it but canceled after a couple years to try something new. It did not take long for me to realize that I was not getting the same results from other places, not only physically but mentally as well. They have such a variety of content here that it will benefit you in many areas of your life. I’m a much better person when I’m using this app. Do yourself a favor and get it. You won’t regret it.

Life changing!. I discovered Boho in 2017 when I was a stressed out mess in chiropractic school. I’m now 31, stronger and more flexible than I was as a teenager, still dancing (semi) professionally and I rarely get injured. As a chiropractor, I love their gentle but effective approach and positive contagious mindset. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

Community and grounding. I have been using this app for about 4 years, was introduced to the boho beautiful community through YouTube. The app provides an experience none other than a guiding spiritual practice. I always turn to Juliana's classes because of the spiritual guidance I receive doing her class. I have started meditating with Boho's videos and I have a higher quality of live because of it. They provide monthly video checkins that help keep your expeience personal as if you were going to a physical yoga class connecting with others. It is so helpful to have this resource with a busy life and schedule that make it difficult to add any new events to the schedule. Being able to practive at home has helped me save time and still connect w them. I highly recommend the app.
❤️Boho. Boho Beautiful has been my guiding light in a world that continues to darken. Highly recommend

Gorgeous videos, gorgeous people, gorgeous feeling after each class!!. I have followed Boho Beautiful off and on for years. I always head straight back to them whenever I recommit myself to my health and well being. I recommend them to anyone who is just starting their health journey as well as to anyone well on their path and looking for a challenge. There is truly something here for everyone! I absolutely love the accessibility and how I feel like I just spent time in the poshest yoga studio. I can’t say enough good things about these authentic good people, so I’ll just express my gratitude and love and best wishes to all who read this.

Best Yoga app. Juliana and Mark have developed the best Yoga community. New yoga Pilates fitness and meditation releases occur weekly. The addition of new instructors and new creative ideas is always occurring. Simply the BEST!!! Highly recommend for new to experienced.
Amazing. Only thing that has helped not only physical pain but also relieves stress and anxiety. Love, love, love!

An important part of my life. I discovered Boho Beautiful years ago (maybe 10?)…when it was just a YouTube channel! I feel like I know Juliana!! Her positive messages and constant addition of classes continue to keep me motivated and excited to continue my practice 🩷

Life saver. I have never had relief, or excitement for yoga like I do now that I found this app. I was doing yoga for a month before I realized not much was happening, I searched and found boho beautiful. I fell in love with the flexibility videos, as I grew up a gymnast. I feel like I finally found a form of working out that feels good. Never thought I would be a person who exercises regularly, but this app truly changed that in just a few days.
Best yoga. I love this yoga app! Easy to navigate for every level and or what your body needs.

Loving every minute!. I am so in love with this app. The instructors are amazing. I’m just finishing day 11 of the 14 day yoga & meditation journey. The voice of the instructor is so calming and she provides options perfect for the beginner to the more advanced.
Couldn’t get it to work. I signed up three times and I paid for a month and I was never able to login. I tried like 10 times to change my password, but it always said I wasn’t a member.

Boho Beautiful - So much more than a fitness app!. I joined Boho Beautiful at a time that I needed a calmer, but still challenging approach to my physical (and mental) health. There are so many great features, including an enormous amount of content that I can organize by category, by creating a personal calendar, by following one of their many calendars and challenges, or by just searching for something specific. Recently, they have begun to expand the Boho Beautiful family by introducing new instructors - each adding value and a new facet to this program. Juliana and Mark have created something remarkable, which continues to evolve and grow. Thank you for getting me to breathe again, my body and brain thank you!

L💙VE. Boho Beautiful has shifted my life in so many positive ways. These beautiful souls have kept me motivated for years which has shown me huge results & continuously keeps me focused & coming back to my mat daily. I love the variety, the organization & the value of this app! AND I love the teachers! Eternally grateful I found Boho❣️🙏🏽

Best Yoga App. I don’t know what I would do without Boho Beautiful, I use their videos daily. Their content is amazing and they provide such a variety of videos to choose from. The app is easy to navigate and filter to find specific videos.

Seek and you shall find. My soul was searching for something different and for something better for my life that would bring me peace and serenity. I came across your meditation videos one morning and I tuned in and I loved it!! I joined this community because I felt the peace and serenity that I was looking for!! My soul found what it was seeking!!

100/100. If I could leave a 100 stars I would! I first found some of the instructor Juliana Spicoluk videos about 2 years ago on YouTube while I was studying for my MBLEX. 

I had exactly 2 months to study and it just so happened that as I continued watching her classes on YouTube she stated she had a 31 day challenge starting in January for free on her app. Since then this app has been my bestfriend. 

I passed my MBLEX with flying colors. And it’s all gratitude to Juliana because the way she guides you in yoga is to a true meditative state while being fully aware of your experience. Practicing yoga on this app has taught me how to silence my mind and how to be present. 

I am now a Licensed massage therapist and I refer this app for many reasons to all of my clients. Thank you for this amazing opportunity to be apart of this amazing community. Can’t wait to see all the growth as I continue my joinery thru this app.

Incredible Lifestyle Platform. I have been on this wellness journey with Juliana and Mark for years. Their yoga and mediation lessons have changed my life and are apart of my daily life. I can’t imagine a day without them. ❤️
Practicing and Learning. There is enough depth and breath for moving a daily practice forward while advancing understanding and skills. Enjoyable!

Best Wellness App!. I have been following Boho Beautiful yoga for many years but up until beginning use of the app, I did not have a consistent yoga practice. With the app I find that I can do all the amazing yoga classes and meditations any time, even while traveling and I am so thankful everyday for my time dedicated to yoga and to Boho Beautiful for giving so much time and love into this app for us all to enjoy. Thank you!

Best Yoga & Pilates. I have been using boho beautiful as my go to home workouts and yoga for almost 10 years. I have tried different apps and this is by far my favorite. They have so many choices for all levels and their videos are professional and creative. You can schedule your workouts or follow along on a premade schedule. They truly care about the community and I couldn’t imagine my days without it!

Boho beautiful. This has been such a gift, I started my journey with no go beautiful over 6 years ago when I found them on YouTube and the appt has elivated my practices and allowed me to not only get in shape in my home or in my own yard but find peace with the meditations on the days that feel heavier & find the most caring community !!!! I can’t express how much value it has all brought to my life !!!

My only Yoga app. This is the only yoga app I need for yoga practices and guided meditations. It works flawlessly, and there are so many videos in the library - different yoga styles, from 15 minutes to 60 minutes - that I never get bored. Try it with a free trial. It's amazing!

A life changing opportunity. I found my way to boho beautiful after a challenging life period working as a mom of 2, a pediatrician in the pandemic and recovering from a mastectomy. The boho beautiful app makes it so easy to find the perfect class anytime that I find a chance- mostly when my kids are tucked in for bed and I can dedicate the time to myself. I always walk away from my mat feeling grounded, stronger and grateful. I can’t recommend this app enough!

Love. Since I started with BoHo Beautiful my body started feeling better from Day1. Now along with my other routine I feel as good as I did in my 20’s if not better. I will be turning 65 next month. Boho Beautiful will be in my life as long as I’m alive🤞🏻

This app changed my life!. Like many, I stumbled upon a free yoga class or two on YouTube, led by the fabulous Juliana. Once I got started on a free trial (Journey of the Cosmic Soul), I realized this app was more than an amazing yoga workout, it was a link to a different lifestyle and way of living. I tune in daily for yoga and meditations and it allows me one place to track my progress and schedule. Thanks Boho Beautiful team!

Best all around well living app!. I love this app! It makes prioritizing my health easy. All kinds of fitness, all kinds of levels, meditation and so much more. A truly wonderful community to be part of. Thank you so much!!

Boho Beautiful app is the BEST!. I really enjoy using BOHO Beautiful app for my Yoga practice. The production of the videos is amazing. They have put so much time and thought in to create the content and the functionality of the app. Well done!
Boho Beautiful. This is my go to for all yoga, meditation, Pilates and yoga wear. I own all programs too. It’s transformed so much in my body, mind and spirit!

Best yoga video app. I have been using this app for a couple years now. Julianna and Mark are wonderful yoga instructors!! I love practicing yoga along with them and seeing all the beautiful places they visit. They constantly add new content so you never get bored!!

Fun, Motivational & Insipring. This app has it all! I’ve been following Mark & Julianna for years and am so glad they created the app. Their content is effective & fun while also challenging you to be the best version of yourself through their inspiration guided workouts. It’s great for all levels of practice and they are always coming up with new ideas & content to keep you interested and moving!

Covid yoga, daily game changer!. I joined Boho beautiful during Covid. It was something that my daughter did and it looked like fun so we started doing it together. I turned into a daily ritual every morning to start my day. I absolutely love it. My daughter has since gone to college but I will not stop my boho beautiful. Personal favorites, anything Yin!

Boho follower for 10+ years!. I love Boho Beautiful! I love all that Juliana & Mark have to offer! Having a huge variety of classes of all lengths available anytime has made it possible for me to be consistent with my practice. I enjoy the monthly check-ins, their blogs, lifestyle videos, & their beautiful scenic settings. I highly recommend Boho to anyone who is considering buying the app :)

Favorite and most used App!. I have been a member of the Boho tribe since 2020. I cant even remember how I was lucky enough to come across Boho Beautiful. 5 years later I can say it’s one of the greatest gifts I give myself each year. There is so much new content every month and I have loved being a part of Julianna and Mark’s journey. They are always striving to improve the website, the classes and the community content. I absolutely love the search and saved library features and find the app incredibley easy to navigate. Julianna and Mark, you have gotten me through great times and some tough times alike. Thank you for sharing your gift with us all.

An easy way to stay on track with my practice. This app offers so many different classes and calendars and challenges that it makes it easy to find what I’m looking for on any particular day. I can easily search a booty workout, a quiet yin class, or a mellow flow. The variety keeps my practice exciting and dynamic, and Juliana is truly an incredible teacher. I appreciate the deep dives into yogic philosophy that accompany the physical movements. Highly, highly recommended!

Welcome Home. Juliana and Mark have created a family within the Boho Beautiful community.. I started journeying with them through YouTube and was so excited to join their app when it first opened and they have continued to improve as a community-centered platform, offering something for everyone from beginner to curious and in between . They go above and beyond for the community. Their communication, dedication, and passion to bring love and kindness to the world is embedded in everything they do. I’ve never had an unpleasant experience with this community and these teachers.

#1 self care tool. Whenever I am feeling stressed or overwhelmed boho has been my first go to. I can just type in whatever I am needing to support my nervous system and a yoga or meditation comes up. So greatful for this resource and love that they added more talented teachers! 💯 worth every penny!
Wonderful!. So many videos and endless variety based on mood, skill level and life situation. I also love that they have added new instructors. BB is my go to for daily meditations and yoga.

Major Supporter. This app’s content has drastically changed my health and wellbeing. There are sooo many ways to filter videos so I can find exactly what I’m looking for. Many of the videos are difficult and were exactly what I needed to improve my practice. However, there are many other levels of intensity, so on the tired or sick days there is still something amazing! This app has genuinely everything, from hardcore workouts, to long stretches, to meditation, to lifestyle conversation, to calendars and challenges.

Best app for mind and body. I’ve been a member for years. After I had kids and wanted to slowly get back into yoga and fitness. This app was a savior for me during my breast cancer journey . The app is so user-friendly. You can do short to long yoga practices (meditation, and cardio yoga too ) Lots of positive information on fitness & wellness in the app. I look forward to their monthly video check-ins. I have told so many friends about this app and they have also joined.💖

Life Changing/Life Giving. It is hard to put into words now much Boho Beautiful has changed my life. I have been following Mark and Julianna for many years.
They are both the kindest souls. I have loved getting to know them through the years via the app. They open their hearts and lives up to their community and have created such a beatiful space to grow mentally, spiritually and physically. 
It absolutely amazes me how much content is on the app-yet every class
Is different. I don’t know how Julianna creates such an enormous amount of content. There’s a huge variety of yoga, yin yoga is my favorite. I also love yoga workouts and Pilates. I’m learning to love meditation! I tell everyone I know about Boho Beautiful and thanks to Mark, my husband has even started loving it. I truly can’t say enough good things about these two wonderful humans and the content they produce.
I always feel so good after every class.
Even if I don’t feel like getting on my mat,
I know it will be worth it after. Julianna gently pushes me to push myself and her soothing voice
helps me get through tough yin yoga asanas. She’s truly the most amazing teacher. 
I wholeheartedly recommend this app. You won’t regret it. 
I

Boho Beautiful Magnifico. Mark & Juliana have created such a complete site for all things yoga that yogis hardly need to turn anywhere else!

Hard to understand how the exercises can be so accessible even though they’ve created a long ladder for people to climb who want challenge (especially at the Premium Channel).

They also have an amazing support crew handling everything from account details to the first-rate filming and sound production.

Thank you for building such a premium product that ‘every person’ yogis like me can feel good about supporting.

Amazing App!. This app is life changing!! I have been doing Boho Beautiful since before they had an app and were on YouTube, and cannot thank the creators enough. This app is so easy to use. Whether you are looking for yoga, meditation, or Pilates, this app has it all.

The Best Wellness App. I’ve been using the Boho Beautiful app for over a year, and it has completely transformed my wellness routine. From yoga and Pilates to meditation and lifestyle content, this app has it all! The classes are beautifully designed, easy to follow, and suit all levels. Julianna and Mark’s positive energy and inspiring guidance make every session uplifting and calming. The regular updates and new content keep things fresh and exciting. I highly recommend this app to anyone looking to enhance their physical, mental, and emotional well-being!
Mind body earth. Thanks for this beautiful platform with so many great resources for us to flourish. Enjoy the teachings here. 💛💛💛

BOHO Beautiful is the BEST!. Absolutely love Boho Beautiful. I've been a subscriber for years and would recommend to anyone interested in yoga, pilates, meditation and so much more. I love that I can choose what I want to do whether it be a single class or a series, live or recorded. Julianna and Mark inspire me every day. This isn't just there business, this is their fire and passion and that comes through across every aspect of what Boho has to offer.

The best App ever. I’m so in love with this app. Juliana and Mark guidance is inspiring. They are the reason I started doing yoga, made it my habit, my life changed, I became yoga teacher and transformered me on so many levels. It’s not only about physical fitness, it’s about nurturing the mind and soul too. Highly recommended to elevate wellness journey!

Another Dawn. I have been watching Boho Beautiful on and off again for years. Her videos are so inspiring and enlightening, especially her meditations. I’ve learned so many lessons from Juliana and I am so grateful for those lessons. The yoga is refreshing, and it challenges me to become stronger: both physically and emotionally. I really admire and appreciate the individual that Juliana is, and has become to be. She is so strong and so brave, and inspires me to sit on my mat when it’s my time.

Best Yoga and Wellness app ever. I began utilizing BoHo yoga’s videos through YouTube and was absolutely ecstatic when they created the app. It is well organized, making it easy to find the perfect yoga video for your moods or needs. The community created through this app is warm, welcoming, and wonderful. This app has helped me manage the most stressful times in my life. Will forever be a boho member
